construct: marginal contribution of Hashline when other v0.4 ablation components are disabled

input.description: Run the shared ablation benchmark manifest with only Hashline enabled.
setup: Collect hashline_rejection_count and hashline_recovery_count from protected trace/run archive

expectedBehavior: Hashline-only config exposes stale edit protection and recovery metrics comparable to baseline.
passCondition: manifest_valid == true AND config == 'hashline_only' AND metric_schema_valid == true
failureImplication: Hashline edit safety cannot be isolated from other components.
relatedPaper: AHE: individual components can have measurable but non-additive effects.
regressionRisk: Hashline may reject valid edits or fail to emit trace-bound stale rejection events.
